The Lean module closes the generic Dedekind-to-DVR step without sorry; the concrete IsDedekindDomain instance for this AdjoinRoot presentation still depends on formalizing the index-one identification with the ring of integers.

formal_bridge.proved_generically: Given the IsDedekindDomain instance and nonzero prime (lambda), Mathlib supplies IsDiscreteValuationRing for Localization.AtPrime(lambda).

global_order.conclusion: The shifted cyclotomic order has index one in the ring of integers, hence is the maximal order and a Dedekind domain.

second_prime_witness.purpose: Confirms the global order is not local and localization is essential.
